description: Message backfill settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.BackfillConfig.

enabled.description: Enable message backfilling from the remote network.

max_initial_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to backfill in a newly created portal.

max_catchup_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to backfill when catching up on missed messages.

unread_hours_threshold.description: Number of hours of unread messages before switching to catchup backfill.

max_initial_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to backfill in a thread.

enabled.description: Enable the backfill queue for processing large backfills in batches.

manual.description: Require manual triggering of queued backfills.

batch_size.description: Number of messages per backfill batch.

batch_delay.description: Delay in seconds between backfill batches.

max_batches.description: Maximum number of batches to process. 0 means unlimited.

max_batches_override.description: Per-portal overrides for max_batches, keyed by portal name.
